Early-onset epilepsy with variable developmental delay; cardiac findings occur in only 1/4.
Umbrella skeletal dysplasia defined by bone fragility and reduced bone density; extra-skeletal damage is not established across most subtypes.
Developmental disability and hypogonadism define syndrome; enamel defects and radioulnar synostosis 80-99%. Renal morphology lacks functional evidence; acne omitted at cap.
Defining cystine transport and mitochondrial metabolic defects, developmental disability and seizures; cystinuria reflects renal tubular dysfunction.
Neoplasm occupies the peritoneal lining of the abdominal cavity; no additional organ damage is established across this umbrella.
Defined by congenital narrowing of the nasal airway and holoprosencephaly, a structural brain malformation.
Age-related lens opacity impairs vision.
Loss of temporal comprehension is a higher cortical perceptual dysfunction.
Skin laxity and skeletal/joint abnormalities; GI diverticula 2/2, high myopia 3/4 and ectropion 3/3 support involvement. Bladder diverticula 3/4 omitted at cap.

Defined by brain dysfunction caused by liver dysfunction or portosystemic shunting; the hepatic-neurologic relationship defines this syndrome.
Anterior pituitary hormone hypersecretion; additional organ damage varies by hormone and subtype.
Tumor family predominantly arises in bone or soft tissue; neural differentiation does not establish nervous-system involvement.
Epiphyseal and vertebral skeletal dysplasia with characteristic hip and knee abnormalities.
Genetic subtype of schizophrenia, a purely psychiatric disorder without established damage to an organ axis.
Mitochondrial myopathy with ophthalmoplegia and ptosis in 5/5; GI dysmotility in 2/5 supports involvement. Neuropathy and hearing loss each 1/5 are excluded.
Enzyme deficiency causes methylmalonic acidemia and metabolic acidosis; some patients are asymptomatic. Sparse neurologic reports do not establish common persistent damage.
Developmental disability and obesity define syndrome; strabismus in 2/3 and refractive impairment at 30-79% support ocular involvement. Pigmented spots do not impair skin.
Cholesterol synthesis defect with ID and defining limb anomalies; reflux and dental abnormalities 80-99% support GI involvement. Cardiac defects (~40-50%) omitted at cap.
Defining vertebral, epiphyseal and metaphyseal dysplasia; hepatosplenomegaly and airway abnormalities are occasional, without established common functional damage.
Poorly differentiated carcinoma originating in the lung; metastatic sites are not defining or consistently involved.
Congenital skeletal myopathy with weakness and muscle pathology; ophthalmoplegia in 4/11 (~36%) supports ocular involvement. Motor delay reflects muscle weakness.
Defining intestinal aganglionosis, nail hypoplasia and distal limb hypoplasia. Hydronephrosis is reported without evidence of common involvement.
Collagen deposition and inflammation damage gastric mucosa. Autoimmune causation is unestablished; secondary iron-deficiency anemia is a separate diagnosis.
